versions.content: For AUTOSAR data types which have an invalidValue speci- fied, the Application Types header file shall contain the definition 1 #define InvalidValue_<prefix><DataType> <invalidValue><suffix> where <prefix> is the optional literalPrefix attribute defined by the Included-DataTypeSet referring the AutosarDataType <DataType> is the short name of the data type. <invalidValue> is the value defined as invalidValue for the data type. <suffix> shall be set according to [SWS_Rte_03619].
